# Survive Verity in Area 51 Field Guide

This fan-made guide uses Roblox Universe ID 10455462279 and Place ID 74716719697996 as stable identifiers across game-title changes.

## Evidence policy

- Official game metrics and Gamepass records come from Roblox endpoints.
- Every changing fact shows a source state and explicit verification date.
- Official facts, official announcements, gameplay tests, community reports, unverified claims, and outdated claims are visually distinct.
- Missing weapon stats, coin routes, map points, and codes are never filled with guesses.

## Current publication status

- Homepage: indexable dashboard.
- Gamepasses: indexable official price catalog; worth-it rankings await gameplay tests.
- Updates: indexable universe-level tracker; the current title announces Cruelty soon.
- Codes: indexable status page; no working redemption system or active code has been verified by this guide as of 2026-07-30.
- Weapons: noindex until at least six evidence-complete weapons exist.
- Coins and Rebirth: noindex until controlled timed runs exist.
- Map: noindex until a real base image and at least eight verified points exist.

This site is not affiliated with Roblox Corporation, Mochi Productions!, or the creators of Verity.
